name: com.tencent.rtmp.video.TXScreenCapture$TXScreenCaptureAssistantActivity
description: When a user starts screen sharing through Tencent LiteAV/TRTC or the Tencent TCIC classroom SDK, this screen opens Android’s system consent prompt and returns the user’s choice to the media SDK.
disableEffect: The selected SDK cannot obtain screen-capture consent through this flow, so screen sharing or recording may not start.
